شُبَّاكَةٌ , (S, O, KL,) or ↓ شُبَّاكٌ , (Msb, TA,) A thing formed of grating, or lattice-work, (↓ مَشْبَكَةٌ , S, O, or مُشَبَّكٌ, KL, TA,) or iron, (S, O, Msb, K, TA,) and of other material [i. e. of wood &c.]: (TA:) and [particularly] a window so formed: (KL:) pl. شَبَابِيكُ. (S, O, TA.) One says, رَأَيْتُهُ ↓ يَنْظُرُ مِنَ الشُّبَّاكِ [I saw him looking from the grated, or latticed, window]. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also شِبَاكٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
